description: This file contains utility functions for input event processing in Android, including button key synthesis, rotation handling, pointer state checking, Bluetooth timestamp smoothing, and related input event logic.

methods.name: synthesizeButtonKey
methods.description: Generates NotifyArgs for button key events based on button state changes.

methods.name: getInverseRotation
methods.description: Returns the inverse rotation of a given orientation.

methods.name: rotateDelta
methods.description: Adjusts deltaX and deltaY based on device rotation.

methods.name: isPointerDown
methods.description: Checks if any pointer button is pressed.

methods.name: synthesizeButtonKeys
methods.description: Synthesizes button key events for back and forward buttons.

methods.name: applyBluetoothTimestampSmoothening
methods.description: Adjusts Bluetooth input event timestamps to smooth out irregularities.
